query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, i.company_name, i.meeting_package, i.is_test
FROM users u
JOIN intake_submissions i ON i.sponsor_id = u.id
WHERE u.role = 'user' AND (i.is_test = 0 OR i.is_test IS NULL)
ORDER BY u.id;
